newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell unit gets GM division deal.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell unit gets GM division deal.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp's railroad electronics business said Friday it received an order from General Motor Corp's electro-motive division valued at more than $10 million.
The order is for 328 sets of integrated cab electronics for trains. Deliveries will begin in May 1997, Rockwell said, and continue through the end of 1998.
The sets replace more than a dozen individual dials and gauges used on older locomotives. Diagnostic information is also provided by the sets, the company said.
Rockwell is an electronics company, providing industrial automation, semiconductors, avionics and communications systems.
